overview_description.description: Plain is a B2B customer support platform that brings conversations from Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, email, chat, and in-app channels into one workspace. It provides AI assistants, automated workflows, customer context, support insights, help centers, APIs, and integrations that help support, engineering, product, and customer teams manage requests and collaborate on issues.

about_short_description.short_description: Plain provides B2B customer support software with AI agents, workflows, APIs, and multi-channel communication tools.

product.name: Plain Support Platform
product.description: A unified customer support platform consolidating multiple communication channels into a single interface for B2B support teams.

product.name: Unified Customer Conversations Platform
product.description: A platform that consolidates customer conversations from various channels like Slack, email, and forms into a single interface for team collaboration.

product.name: Plain AI Features
product.description: AI-driven automation for triaging, labeling, summarizing, and suggesting responses to support requests.

product.name: Slack Integration
product.description: Allows users to communicate with customers directly on Slack without needing to switch platforms.

product.name: Email Support
product.description: Supports up to 5 shared email addresses for centralized email management.
